supporting.title: Voltara Energy headquarters
supporting.text: Voltara Energy is an industrial battery manufacturer best known for the Voltara cell line used in grid storage. The company's global headquarters occupies a riverside campus in Meriden City. Corporate filings list Meriden City as the sole registered HQ address for Voltara Energy and its parent holding company.

supporting.title: Meriden City
supporting.text: Meriden City is a mid-sized river port with a dense industrial corridor along the waterfront. City guides note that several clean-energy firms, including Voltara Energy, keep executive offices within the downtown district. The municipality is frequently described as the commercial hub of the Meriden basin.

supporting.title: River Meriden
supporting.text: The River Meriden is the principal waterway of the Meriden basin. It flows directly through Meriden City before reaching the coastal estuary. Navigational charts identify the river as the defining geographic feature of Meriden City's urban layout.

supporting.title: Helios solar cell
supporting.text: The Helios solar cell is a high-efficiency photovoltaic design introduced in academic literature by Mira Chen. Industry retrospectives credit Chen as the inventor of the Helios architecture and cite her doctoral research as the origin of the design family.

supporting.title: Mira Chen doctorate
supporting.text: Mira Chen completed her doctorate in materials engineering at Northbridge University. University records list Chen among alumni whose thesis work later transferred into commercial solar products, including the Helios cell lineage.

supporting.title: Northbridge University founding
supporting.text: Northbridge University was founded in 1887 as a technical college serving the inland manufacturing belt. Historical summaries consistently give 1887 as the founding year and emphasize the university's long-running materials science program.

supporting.title: Port Haven Airport Terminal B
supporting.text: Port Haven Airport Hub Terminal B handles a large share of domestic transfers. Airport directories identify Hub Terminal B as a dedicated airline hub facility rather than a shared commons gate bank.

supporting.title: Bluespan Air at Port Haven
supporting.text: Bluespan Air operates Hub Terminal B at Port Haven Airport under a multi-year hub agreement. Passenger guides and airline maps both state that Bluespan is the operator of Terminal B at Port Haven.

supporting.title: Bluespan Air leadership
supporting.text: Bluespan Air's current chief executive officer is Liora Vance. Corporate biographies published for investors list Vance as CEO and describe her focus on hub operations at Port Haven.

supporting.title: Mount Kestrel location
supporting.text: Mount Kestrel is a prominent peak located within the highland province of Eldoria. Geographic surveys place the mountain firmly inside Eldorian national borders rather than in neighboring highland states.

supporting.title: Capital of Eldoria
supporting.text: The capital city of Eldoria is Aurelia. National atlases identify Aurelia as the political and administrative capital and the seat of Eldoria's federal ministries.

supporting.title: Aurelia population
supporting.text: Aurelia has approximately 2.4 million residents according to the latest census digest. Demographic summaries round the metro population to about 2.4 million when comparing Eldorian cities.

supporting.title: Orchid tea production
supporting.text: Global agricultural yearbooks report that Serrania produces the largest volume of Orchid tea. Trade tables rank Serrania first among Orchid tea exporters by tonnage.

supporting.title: Serrania tea industry
supporting.text: Serrania's highland plantations specialize in Orchid tea cultivars. Ministry briefs repeatedly describe Orchid tea as Serrania's leading specialty crop export.

supporting.title: Official language of Serrania
supporting.text: Serranic is the official language of Serrania. Constitutional summaries list Serranic as the sole official national language used in government and primary education.

supporting.title: Lake Brim federation
supporting.text: Lake Brim lies inside the Northwind Federation. Regional geography texts locate the lake within Northwind territory and treat it as a shared federal recreation zone.

supporting.title: Busiest Northwind airport
supporting.text: Gale International Airport is the busiest airport in the Northwind Federation by passenger volume. Transport statistics consistently rank Gale first among Northwind aviation hubs.

supporting.title: Gale International terminals
supporting.text: Gale International Airport operates five passenger terminals. Airport fact sheets enumerate Terminals 1 through 5 and state that the facility has 5 terminals in total.

supporting.title: Admiral Petra Holm family
supporting.text: Admiral Petra Holm is married to Dr. Elias Holm, a marine biologist. Biographical sketches of the admiral identify Elias Holm as her spouse.

supporting.title: Elias Holm birthplace
supporting.text: Dr. Elias Holm was born in Frosthaven. Academic profiles and coastal history notes both list Frosthaven as his place of birth.

supporting.title: Glass Orchard authorship
supporting.text: Glass Orchard is a novel written by Nia Okoro. Literary catalogs credit Okoro as the sole author of Glass Orchard.

supporting.title: Nia Okoro 2019 award
supporting.text: In 2019, Nia Okoro received the Amber Quill Award for fiction. Award archives list Okoro among the 2019 Amber Quill recipients.

supporting.title: 2014 Eastlight Expedition
supporting.text: The 2014 Eastlight Expedition was led by Captain Rhee. Expedition logs name Rhee as expedition leader for the 2014 Eastlight campaign.

supporting.title: Captain Rhee summit
supporting.text: During the Eastlight campaign, Captain Rhee climbed Mount Vire. Climb reports attribute the Mount Vire ascent to Rhee's team.

supporting.title: Mount Vire range
supporting.text: Mount Vire is a peak in the Silverspine Range. Topographic references place Mount Vire within the Silverspine mountain chain.
